page.layout: One block of running text in a single column, with a running head above the text. Below the last line is a small signature mark at the right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: QVI veram ac simplicem Christiana Religionis doctrinam ex ipsis Apostolorum temporibus reuocatam, ac repetitam, insolentia atque novitatis insimulant, unde tandem hi Martyres hodie prodeant, miraturos esse minime dubitamus: quum iidem, à multis iam annis huiusmodi Athletarum amissa memoria, vel potius iam intermissa videri possit. Quibus ut respondeamus, sic habeant: ut de illis ipsi nihil nec audiverint nec audire profecto voluerint, non idcirco haud amissam illorum, haud intermissam videri oportere memoriam. Nam ut istis demus, statis temporum interuallis prostratam ac iacentem quodammodo fuisse Christi Ecclesiam; extinctam certe fuisse prorsus sine scelere pronuntiare non possumus. Quod quidem ex eo intelligi potest, quoniam alio tempore plures, alio vero pauciores, nunquam certe nulli Martyres extiterunt: nimirum vlli qui sic Christiana doctrina testes ac praecones extiterint, ut eam suo sanguine obsignare non dubitarent. At vero quum Ecclesiam ipsam aliquandiu iacentem inquam, & quodammodo sopitam Christus longè ampliorem & illustriorem, centum circiter, aut eo amplius, annis ipse renocarit, maiorem etiam qui pro causa sua defensionem pugnarent numerum excitauit. Nam, Vt penè extinctum cinerem si sulphure tangas, Viuet & ex minimo maximus ignis erit. Itaque quum Christus suo sulphure, feruore nempe Spiritus sui, Fidelium animos propè

page.notes: The printed text is Latin in italic type with long words and ligatures. Some letters in the scan are worn, especially at the line ends, but I was able to read the page. The "ii." at the bottom right is a signature mark and is given under bottom_margin. The running head is ADMONITIO. in capitals. The page has no page number printed at the head or foot. The text ends mid-sentence at "propè" and continues on the next page. The Latin contains the words "vlli", "iidem", and "testes" as printed; the printing is not corrected. The word "centum circiter" and the surrounding clause are read as printed. Some uncertain readings are marked nowhere because the scan is clear enough for them; minor doubts about "nunquam" (printed "nunquā" with a macron) are noted here.
